Callout.Name: Diabetic Emergency
Callout.Message: Diabetic person unwell, conscious but confused.
Callout.Advisory: Family present, no insulin taken today.

Script.Line: I have not eaten since yesterday. It slipped my mind completely.
My hands are shaking and I cannot get a thought to stay still.
Sugar. Anything with sugar in it. Orange juice if anybody has one.

Callout.Patient: I just need something sweet. I know what it is.

Lines.Approach: The family are with her. She is confused and has not eaten today.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
